user.title: Material Home Assistant Configuration
user.description: Enter the details associated with your license to correctly activate the integration and unlock all available features.

manual_resource.title: Manual Action Required
manual_resource.description:
The Lovelace resource required for the component to work could not be added automatically.

To complete the configuration, please carefully follow these steps:

1. Open **Settings** > **Dashboards**.
2. Click the three dots in the top-right corner and select **Resources**.
3. Click **Add Resource**.
4. Paste the following URL: `{url}`.
5. Select **JavaScript Module** as the resource type and save your changes.

Once completed, the resource will be available for use.

Press the button below once the resource has been added.
